DECLARE @p INT=0; BEGIN TRY INSERT INTO output_ref(id,n,t) OUTPUT inserted.id,10/@p SELECT 30,3,N'tri' WHERE 1=1; END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS number,ERROR_STATE() AS state,XACT_STATE() AS xact; END CATCH
SELECT id,n,t FROM output_ref ORDER BY id; SELECT a,b FROM output_sink ORDER BY a,b
